message.content: {"note_claim": "NATO Article 5 applies only to armed attacks on member territory in Europe or North America or specified North Atlantic areas north of the Tropic of Cancer, so it does not cover bases in the UAE.", "label": "PARTIAL", "quote": "if such an armed attack occurs, each of them, in exercise of the right of individual or collective self-defence recognised by Article 51 of the Charter of the United Nations, will assist the Party or Parties so attacked", "reason": "The page explains Article 5 generally and refers to the 'North Atlantic area' but never states the territorial limits (Europe, North America, north of the Tropic of Cancer) or addresses the UAE."}

parsed.note_claim: NATO Article 5 applies only to armed attacks on member territory in Europe or North America or specified North Atlantic areas north of the Tropic of Cancer, so it does not cover bases in the UAE.
parsed.label: PARTIAL
parsed.quote: if such an armed attack occurs, each of them, in exercise of the right of individual or collective self-defence recognised by Article 51 of the Charter of the United Nations, will assist the Party or Parties so attacked
parsed.reason: The page explains Article 5 generally and refers to the 'North Atlantic area' but never states the territorial limits (Europe, North America, north of the Tropic of Cancer) or addresses the UAE.
